page_title: MAI 3-1 DOR | Mainz v Dortmund 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Bo Henriksen decides to make a substitution. Jonathan Burkardt will be replaced by Karim Onisiwo (Mainz).
90' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jae-Sung Lee as he is replaced by Armindo Sieb (Mainz).
90' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) sends it out of play.
87' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
86' Robin Zentner (Mainz) picks up a yellow card.
86' Substitution. Paul Nebel makes way for Hyun-Seok Hong (Mainz).
83' What an opportunity! Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) wins the ball from the resulting set piece and unleashes a precise shot from inside the goal area which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
80' The substitution has been made. Silvan Widmer (Mainz) has replaced Danny da Costa.
74' Nuri Sahin has decided to make a change. Cole Campbell (Dortmund) replaces Julian Brandt.
74' A substitution has been made. Julian Ryerson is replaced by Almugera Kabar (Dortmund).
73' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
72' A quickly taken corner by Mainz.
70' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) commits a rough foul. Florian Badstubner stops the game and makes a call.
64' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) took the corner.
63' A corner kick by Mainz is thwarted by the well prepared Alexander Meyer (Dortmund). The ball is out of play. Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner.

63' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play and Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yan Couto (Dortmund) comes onto the pitch for Jamie Gittens.
59' Here is a change. Maximilian Beier is going off and Nuri Sahin gives the last tactical orders to Donyell Malen (Dortmund).
59' It is time for a substitution. Yannik Luhrs (Dortmund) is on for Felix Nmecha.
54' 3 - 1 Goal! Phillipp Mwene plays it to Paul Nebel (Mainz), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Alexander Meyer. 3:1.
52' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
52' Mainz have a corner.
51' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom left corner is thwarted by Alexander Meyer.
49' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
46' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) strikes a first-time volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort is way off target and the ball goes well wide of the right post.
46' Referee Florian Badstubner blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+3' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the top right corner. The assist goes to Danny da Costa and the score changes to 2:1.
45+1' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) receives a nice pass from the free kick and strikes from the edge of the box, but his attempt hits one of the defenders and bounces away off him.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is awarded a yellow card.
43' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner way wide of the left post.
43' Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
43' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) is able to continue to play.
41' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' 1 - 1 Goal! Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) puts the ball into the left side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Robin Zentner.
40' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
39' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle after Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Dortmund have been awarded a penalty kick!

36' 1 - 0 Anthony Caci produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:0.
32' Paul Nebel (Mainz) unnecessarily kicks the ball off the pitch. Paul Nebel (Mainz) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
30' Anthony Caci (Mainz) is adjudged offside.

29' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) latches onto a precise lofted pass into the penalty area and produces a header at goal, but his attempt under the bar fails to beat Alexander Meyer, who makes a sensational save.
28' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) says something out of turn to the referee and is shown a yellow card.
27' Emre Can (Dortmund) knows that the game is over for him after receiving a red card from the referee for fouling his opponent!
26' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle and it's Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
23' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
19' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
18' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) rips an amazing volley from deep inside the box that goes narrowly over the crossbar.
14' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
11' A cross is whipped into the box by Pascal Gross (Dortmund) and Serhou Guirassy controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
10' The Dortmund players are exchanging some short passes.
7' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
5' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Florian Badstubner no option but to blow his whistle.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Dortmund will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Florian Badstubner.
